title: Prominence on 30A Don't Worry Beach Happy Prominence on 30A
meta_description: Prominence - Dont Worry Beach Happy - Beach, 2 Pools - Golf Cart, Pet Friendly
description_expanded: AboutProminence on 30A – Don’t Worry Beach Happy by Panhandle Getaways is a luxurious pet-friendly beach house in Watersound, FL, featuring Gulf views from all three balconies, spacious coastal interiors, and resort-style amenities within the Prominence community. This stunning multi-level retreat includes an elevator, six bedrooms, and a 6-seater golf cart. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card to share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Welcome to Don’t Worry Beach Happy, a 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom beach house in Watersound, Florida by Panhandle Getaways. Perfect for large families or groups, this coastal retreat offers bright, open living spaces, a fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar, and three balconies showcasing breathtaking Gulf views. Enjoy the convenience of an elevator, multiple king suites, and a 6-seater golf cart for exploring 30A’s scenic bike paths, beaches, and The Big Chill—all just minutes away. HOME FEATURES • 30A 6-bedroom beach house with Gulf views • Golf cart included - 6 Seater • Pet-friendly property • 3 balconies with breathtaking Gulf views • Elevator for easy access between levels • Spacious living area with 75" Smart TV • Fully equipped kitchen with breakfast bar • Bedroom 1: King bed, coffee bar, sitting area, 70" TV, walk-in closets, en suite bathroom • Bedroom 2: King bed, 65" TV, en suite bathroom • Bedroom 3: King bed, 65" TV, en suite bathroom • Bedroom 4: King bed, 58" TV, en suite bathroom • Bedroom 5: King bed, 58" TV • Bedroom 6: Two full-over-full bunk beds, 65" TV • Full-size washer and dryer • Complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi • Parking for 3 cars + golf cart • Sleeps 12–18 guests ABOUT PROMINENCE ON 30A - WATERSOUND, FL Prominence on 30A is one of the most popular communities along Scenic Highway 30A, offering incredible amenities, open green spaces, and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Perfectly located near 30A favorites and the area’s sugar-white beaches, Prominence features a charming town center and two resort-style pools. At the heart of it all, The Big Chill is a lively gathering place featuring an outdoor 25-foot LED theater screen for concerts, movie nights, and sporting events, as well as boutique shops, family-friendly activities, and excellent dining options. Centrally situated between Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to the east, Prominence places you right in the middle of everything that makes 30A special. COMMUNITY & THE BIG CHILL AMENITIES • Two resort-style zero-entry pools – perfect for all ages • Walking distance to The Big Chill – dining, shops, and nightly entertainment • Luke Bryan’s cigar and gastro pub – a favorite local hangout • Family movie nights and live sports on the outdoor big screen • Onsite ice machine and barbecue grilling areas • Close to Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Seaside • 3.5 miles to the nearest grocery store 30A PUBLIC BEACH ACCESS POINTS Beach access for all Prominence homes is available through South Walton public beach access points. Most guests use Deer Lake State Park or other nearby public accesses along 30A. Please note that Prominence homes do not have direct beach access through Watersound Club and do not include access to Watersound private club facilities. FREE DAILY ACTIVITIES INCLUDED Guests enjoy FREE daily activities through our Xplorie partnership: • 1 FREE round of golf each day at 1 of 4 nearby courses (year-round) • 4 bikes ready to ride (year-round) • 1 FREE dolphin cruise or snorkel trip per day (March–October) PET POLICY We welcome well-trained, potty-trained dogs (preferably older than 2 years). Crate-trained pups are encouraged to prevent unsupervised damage while guests are away. Any pet-related damage will incur a minimum $350 fee. Additional non-refundable pet fee applies and is collected after booking. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION A starter pack of toiletries, paper products, and detergents is provided for your arrival. Guests should plan to purchase additional supplies for the remainder of their stay. Bed linens and bath towels are included; please bring beach towels for pool and beach use. The community’s pool heating schedule is determined by the HOA and is subject to change at any time. Panhandle Getaways is not responsible for any changes to pool heating or availability. Security devices are located on the exterior of the home. WHY WE LOVE IT Don’t Worry Beach Happy is a showstopping 30A getaway designed for family fun, relaxation, and effortless coastal living. From morning coffee on the balcony overlooking the Gulf to sunset cruises in your golf cart to The Big Chill, every moment here feels like vacation perfection. With plenty of space, luxury finishes, and incredible views, it’s the ultimate 30A escape for families, groups, and beach lovers alike.
